decision: Selected the centroid of the union of seven contiguous Bastrop County parcels held by EdgeConneX entities on FM 535 near Cedar Creek: the five EdgeConneX Bastrop Campus Condominium 01 parcels (units 1-4 and the general common element), the adjoining DFW33220N LLC tract 24749 and EdgeConneX MCN Austin Property 5 LLC's 179.166-acre tract 22339 (situs 6682 FM 535). It locates EdgeConneX's Bastrop campus (293.18 geodesic acres), not the EDCAUS13 building, its footprint or any works.

identity_bridge: TDLR TABS2026028410 'EDCAUS13' (registered 2026-08-20): new construction of a 729,537 sq ft one-story data center with supporting office space at 6682 FM 535, Cedar Creek, Bastrop County; EDCAUS11, EDCAUS12 (May 2026) and EDCAUS14 (2026-08-20) register identical buildings at the same address; registration owner Burr Computer Environment Inc.

Parcel 22339's situs is 6682 FM 535 and its owner is EdgeConneX MCN Austin Property 5 LLC, mailing address 2201 Cooperative Way Ste 400, Herndon VA, which EdgeConneX's own pages print as its global headquarters. The CAPCOG 9-1-1 point for 6682 FM 535 lies about 19 m outside the tract, in a 2.806-acre Bastrop County WCID No. 3 parcel.

EdgeConneX's Austin location page gives AUS01 at 6752 FM535, Cedar Creek, 96 MW phase one on a 130-acre master-planned site, with AUS02-04 as further phases, and calls EdgeConneX facilities 'EDC locations'; the 9-1-1 point for 6752 FM 535 falls in the condominium's general-common-element parcel.

TDLR TABS2025023484 'ECX AUSTIN DFW33220N' (2025-07-14): facility AUS02 at 8001 Wolf Ln Bldg 2 / 6752 FM 535, owner DFW33220N, LLC at 2201 Cooperative Way Suite 400, Herndon; DFW33220N LLC owns the condominium general common element, unit 2 and tract 24749.
The condominium parcels' legal descriptions name 'EDGECONNEX BASTROP CAMPUS CONDOMINIUM 01'; units 1, 3 and 4 are owned by EdgeConneX MCN Austin Property 2, 3 and 4 LLC.
EdgeConneX's release of 7 August 2026 (dateline Bastrop, Texas) refers to its development of a new technology campus in Bastrop County near Austin.
alternatives_rejected: Tract 22339 alone: would separate the EDCAUS11-14 tract from the adjoining AUS01 condominium it touches.
EdgeConneX MCN Austin Property 7 LLC's 400.58-acre tract 35120 (A226 Lindsey): not contiguous with these parcels (Uppingham Adams Holdings LLC land lies between), so it is excluded.

Uppingham Adams Holdings LLC parcels 34648 (702.818 acres, situs 6543 FM 535, the address of the EDCAUS31/32 registrations) and 297683 (853.933 acres): a different owner not shown to be an EdgeConneX entity; excluded.
6402 FM 535 (EDCAUS15/16): its 9-1-1 point falls in parcel 55674, which has no owner or legal description in the snapshot; excluded.
Census or commercial geocoders: not used.

consistency_checks.owner_match: parcel owners are EdgeConneX-named LLCs or DFW33220N LLC, all at EdgeConneX's Herndon headquarters address
consistency_checks.registration_match: parcel 22339 situs equals the EDCAUS13 registered address
consistency_checks.area_note: condominium plus tract 24749 is 114.4 acres against the operator's 130-acre AUS01 site; with tract 22339 the union is 293.18 acres
